heroes.name: Kael
heroes.desc: A resilient warrior who protects allies with shields of fire.
heroes.pass: Takes 20% less periodic damage. In defense, the shield bonus protects the piloted tower.
heroes.attack: Creates a shield of 100 for herself and 50 for nearby Runners for 5 s.
heroes.def: The selected tower receives temporary shield of 80 for 5 s.

bio.name: Kael
bio.story: For years, she safeguarded pieces and transport of splotyt, learning to contain the fire before it threatened others. In Trials, she defends her team and strengthens the towers.
bio.reason: Represents workshop districts fighting for fair access to fuel.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Thora
heroes.desc: A root guardian who accepts arrows and supports nearby allies.
heroes.pass: Receives 15% more healing; strengthens its own shield repair.
heroes.attack: Heals allies and enemies within range for 5 s.
heroes.def: Restores 46 tower shields and reduces damage by 4 s.

bio.name: Thora
bio.story: Years of rebuilding destroyed fields taught her that the strongest defender is at the back, only when others are safe. Combines resilience with a concern for the team.
bio.reason: Fights in Trials to secure provisions for the valley and funds for reconstruction.
bio.family: No relation established with three sisters; her family remains open.

heroes.name: Brom
heroes.desc: Unbreakable defender who shields the team from enemy attacks.
heroes.pass: Takes 10% less damage from direct hits.
heroes.attack: Raises a shield for 4 seconds. Allies can hide behind it.
heroes.def: Selected tower takes 30% less damage for 5 seconds.

bio.name: Brom
bio.story: As a mine guard, he protected workers during collapses and helped maintain passage routes. In the labyrinth, he uses his shield to allow others to proceed.
bio.reason: Represents the mining community fighting for a safe supply route.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Morrak
heroes.desc: A silent guardian of shadow who turns incoming fire into an opportunity to dodge.
heroes.attack: For 4s, slows nearby flying projectiles by 50%.
heroes.def: Makes it harder to target the selected tower from a greater distance.

bio.name: Morrak
bio.story: The silent guardian appeared in the port after the war. No one knows whether Morrak was constructed or shaped differently; the guardian focuses on protecting others.
bio.reason: Joins escort teams after witnessing the cost of losing a safe path.
bio.family: Morrak’s origin and any family ties remain a mystery.

heroes.name: Niva
heroes.desc: A caretaker who removes slows and restores towers to working order.
heroes.pass: Slows are weaker, and controlled tower outages are shorter.
heroes.attack: Removes an ally's slow effect and protects them from it for 2 seconds.
heroes.def: Removes the temporary disable of one live tower.

bio.name: Niva
bio.story: Grew up with her sisters in the southern valley, then trained at the White Cavern. Uses icy abilities to protect and restore functionality.
bio.reason: Begins to support the supply exchange between the valley and the north.
bio.family: Sisters Eliry and Liory; their team choices do not have to be the same.

heroes.name: Varek
heroes.desc: An energetic leader who synchronizes the movement of the entire team.
heroes.pass: For a short time, speeds up after using the skill.
heroes.attack: Speeds up nearby Runners and mobs by 25% for 3 seconds.
heroes.def: The selected tower's automatic shot is faster by 5 seconds.

bio.name: Varek
bio.story: Worked on repairing transmitters where seconds often decided whether the message arrived in time. In Trials, teaches allies to act in unison.
bio.reason: Represents residents maintaining connectivity on less prosperous sections of the path.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Liora
heroes.desc: A weaver of renewal who heals the team and strengthens defenses.
heroes.pass: Her healing and repair are 10% stronger.
heroes.attack: Creates a healing field for allies and enemies for 5 s.
heroes.def: Restores 66 HP and 44 shields of the selected living tower.

bio.name: Liora
bio.story: She was in the valley to help the injured and rebuild places after past battles. In the team, she heals and strengthens defense.
bio.reason: Seeks means for clinics and rebuilding fields.
bio.family: Sister of Nivy and Eliry; a similar appearance does not give any bonus in the game.

heroes.name: Elira
heroes.desc: A beacon keeper who helps the team spot threats.
heroes.pass: Detected targets remain visible to the team for one second longer.
heroes.attack: Briefly reveals towers in the selected path segment.
heroes.def: Detects Runners and mobs in the selected sector.

bio.name: Elira
bio.story: Departed from her family's valley to study at the Aurelu Lighthouse, learning mapping and observer work. Her light helps the team see threats.
bio.reason: Participates so that knowledge of routes remains accessible even to smaller cities.
bio.family: Sister of Nivy and Liory; their family background does not force a shared composition.

heroes.name: Rian
heroes.desc: A precise specialist who targets specific defense points.
heroes.attack: Deals 100 damage to a selected revealed tower.
heroes.def: Marks the Runner as the preferred target for automatic towers.

bio.name: Rian
bio.story: Worked on emitter calibration and learned to identify weak points in mechanisms. In Trials, she uses this knowledge for precise sabotage.
bio.reason: Wants to acquire resources for an open workshop teaching safe tower operation.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Saila
heroes.desc: An ice saboteur who opens a safe passage for the team.
heroes.pass: Slows effects acting on her by 15%.
heroes.attack: Disables one discovered tower for 3 seconds.
heroes.def: Creates a slowing zone along the path for enemies.

bio.name: Saila
bio.specialty: Freezing towers and controlling the route
bio.story: Knows ice devices used to maintain warehouses; learned to temporarily disable mechanisms without destroying the entire network.
bio.reason: Represents the garrison of the pass fighting for equal time usage of the path.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Zet
heroes.desc: A lightning-fast scout searching for weak defense points.
heroes.pass: After using the ability, moves faster for 2 seconds.
heroes.attack: Disables one discovered tower for 2 seconds.
heroes.def: Briefly detects Runners and mobs in a selected area.

bio.name: Zet
bio.story: Delivered urgent messages between relay stations. His speed and device intuition proved useful later in labyrinths.
bio.reason: Joins to support the network of small stations threatened by closure.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Morven
heroes.desc: A master of disruptions who erases information and disorients automatons.
heroes.pass: After using the ability, it becomes harder to detect him for a short time.
heroes.attack: Reduces the accuracy of the selected tower's automatic fire.
heroes.def: Makes it more difficult to discover unknown towers in the chosen area.

bio.name: Morven
bio.story: Grew up among crews protecting convoys from revealing their routes. Uses his masking skills today to disrupt detection.
bio.reason: Begins in the name of carriers who demand safe and fairly distributed routes.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.defense: Fix Itself (proposal): four outcomes at 25% each — 50 shield, +50% attack speed for 5 s, +50% projectile speed for 5 s, or an unlucky result that stops the tower for 3 s.
heroes.desc: One Lucky Bastard: four outcomes at 25% each — stop a tower for 5 s, permanently disable a tower in defense, give it a 50% miss chance until the end of the round, or, on a bad roll, increase its attack speed by 50% for 5 s. Details to be determined.

bio.name: Nocten
bio.city: Northern Riftoryn settlement (according to official records)
bio.specialty: Darkness magic — concealing allies and weakening opponents
bio.story:
Age in 12 AT: 68.

According to official records, Nocten was born in a small settlement in northern Riftoryn. Yet he also remembers another life: a city behind high white walls, a woman he loved, and a boy who called him father. At the same time, he remembers growing up in the settlement. Both pasts feel equally real.

In everyday life, Nocten is sensible, patient and quietly funny. He is an experienced Darkness mage who conceals allies, weakens opponents and manipulates shadows; he does not think his element erases memories. But he is unsettled by memories that contradict one another, and by a shadow that sometimes seems to move without him—a sight no one else has witnessed.

In an old archive, he found a map leading to the city from his dreams. When he returned the next day, the same road led elsewhere, though the archivist insisted the map had not changed. Nocten began writing down his memories and dreams; in his notebook, he found contradictory notes in his own handwriting that he could not remember writing.

In one notebook he found the line, “When the representatives of the seven elements gather again, you must be there,” followed by the date of this year's Great Games. He comes, not knowing who wrote it or whether he remembers someone else's past or his own. No explanation for his memories is confirmed.
bio.reason: He comes to the Great Games because of a note he cannot remember writing, hoping to meet someone who recognizes his memories.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.

heroes.name: Adrien
heroes.defense: Tower Specialist: Adrian's piloted tower cannot be stopped in any way.
heroes.desc: Character in development.

bio.name: Adrien
bio.specialty: Light inventor — prismatic instruments and stabilization of splotite-powered devices
bio.story:
Age in 12 AT: 30.

Adrien trained at the Aurelian Lighthouse, but for years he has rarely left his own workshop. He prefers tools to people, endlessly experimenting with prototypes that use splotite and trying to make his designs as reliable as possible. People call him mad, but workshops, observatories and carriers buy his inventions.

Brilliant, arrogant and impatient, Adrien believes he is responsible for the quality of his technology, not for whether others use it for good or ill. He is accused of supplying devices to saboteurs, though there is no proof that he gave them anything. He will not stop designing or take responsibility for other people's decisions.

He considered past competitions beneath his time. He enters the exceptional Great Games out of vanity, hoping to win fame and prove he is better than everyone else.
bio.reason: He enters the exceptional Great Games out of vanity and a desire for fame, intending to prove his superiority.
bio.family: Family has not been described yet.
